question:
What should come in place of the question mark (?) in the given series?

249 232 215 198 181 ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The sequence follows a pattern of constant subtraction.

249 − 232 = 17

232 − 215 = 17

The pattern is to subtract 17 from the previous number.

Next number = 181 − 17 = 164.

**∴ The correct answer is 164.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**
